workerResult.summary: Ghost Antenna: leave messages for strangers' radios. Grunge FM-band tuner with a draggable dial + ruler, CRT static-viz that thins out on lock, character-by-character message decode, torn-paper signal board, and a broadcast composer (localStorage only). Daily-seeded ether stations, arrow-key tuning, haptics, film grain, reduced-motion support. Fixed a Composer send-button brick, added localStorage shape validation, mobile ruler-label collisions, marquee aria-hidden, and reduced-motion coverage for canvas/cursor/pulse animations.
